update_average_compute_ema: compute the exponential moving average of a new value given a beta decay factor and old value
update_moving_average_sync_model_params: update a model's parameters with the exponential moving average of another model's parameters using a beta decay factor
update_average_handle_none_initial: compute the exponential moving average that returns the new value directly when the old value is None
update_moving_average_detach_and_update: detach current model parameters and update the moving average model parameters in place using a beta decay factor
update_average_weighted_blend: compute a weighted blend between an old value and a new value using a configurable beta decay factor
